newsitem.title: USA: Greenspan loath to up stock margin requirements.
newsitem.headline: Greenspan loath to up stock margin requirements.

text.p: Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan indicated on Wednesday that he would be loath to raise stock margin requirements to try to cool off the equity market.

Noting that the central bank has not raised margin requirements since 1974, Greenspan told a House Banking subcommittee that the requirements were "anachronisms" and should not be under the purview of the Fed.
"It's not obvious what these margin authorities essentially do," he added.
Greenspan declined to say if he thought stock prices were too high or too low. Earlier this month, the Fed chief suggested that the market might be overvalued.
